source: Fan settings, not official: dotted-eighth delay at 123 BPM (Line 6 CustomTone 3964711, ToneLib forum threads); clean Fender-style amp; light comp; hall reverb. v1 used AnalogDly Repeat 35 / Mix 48 (the Line 6 numbers) and the repeats were inaudible on the pedal; v2 uses the clean Delay, Repeat 60 (cf. the Zoom B1on fan preset, F.B 63), Mix 55.
